fields.name: working_area
fields.meaning: Live game state kept in battery RAM while playing (unit tables, map data, counters). Not a save file: it is not read back at power-on, and saving copies parts of it into a file
fields.evidence: diffs across play (changes constantly without saving); boot reads only file bytes; writers 4c6c:1b5e/1cb8/1d60/1e1d copy from it

fields.name: slots
fields.meaning: Three save files of 0x1AA4 bytes, file n (n=1..3) at 0x3000 + (n-1)*0x1AA4 (0x3000, 0x4AA4, 0x6548). Rows below use file-1 offsets; every file has the same layout
fields.evidence: code c000:00f6/c000:08fe (segment 0x1300 + n*0x1AA4, n<3 at c000:0170); all three files written by playing; screen lists 3 files

fields.name: magic
fields.meaning: Text "WV"; a file without it shows as NO DATA
fields.evidence: code 4c6c:18ec (write), 4c6c:17d1 (check); blank-vs-saved diff

fields.name: valid_flag
fields.meaning: Always 0 in a good file; the file is only accepted when this byte is 0
fields.evidence: code 4c6c:1904 (write 0), 4c6c:17f2 (check)

fields.name: turn
fields.meaning: Turn number shown in the file list ("1ターン"); 0 shows a different label instead of a turn
fields.evidence: code 4c6c:1998 (from turn counter), c000:0347/c000:0389 (list display); turn-1 vs turn-2 saves

fields.name: area
fields.meaning: Current map/area number; picks the area name shown in the file list (1 = space patrol area); value 0x35 shows a special label
fields.evidence: code 4c6c:1998, c000:0273/c000:02b7 (name table lookup); value 1 with name on screen

fields.name: option_flags
fields.meaning: Bit flags (bits 0 and 1 are switched on/off by one menu routine); likely game settings
fields.evidence: code 4c6c:1940; bits set/cleared at 8000:6ec4; value 0 in all saves

fields.name: map_view
fields.meaning: Four map position bytes (map cursor and view position on the battle map)
fields.evidence: code 4c6c:1960; cursor move changed bytes 0-1 (03 03 -> 12 09); scroll routine 8000:877f steps of 3

fields.name: play_time
fields.meaning: Total play time in frames (75 per second; 4500 per minute), capped at 100 hours; the list shows hours and minutes
fields.evidence: code 4c6c:191c, c000:002a (+1 per frame, cap 0x019BFCC0), c000:0045/c000:0098 (hours, minutes); 31097 frames shown as 0h06m; +330 frames over 4.4 s between saves

fields.name: supply_points
fields.meaning: Supply points (0-999999) shown in the file list
fields.evidence: code 4c6c:1998, c000:0402 (list display), tally routine 4c6c:0df5 (clamps 0..999999); value 0 shown as 0

fields.name: stage_counter_a
fields.meaning: Counter cleared when a stage starts
fields.evidence: code 4c6c:1998 (copy), a000:0c9a (reset to 0); value 0 in all saves

fields.name: stage_counter_b
fields.meaning: Counter cleared when a stage starts; added as a bonus term in the post-stage supply tally
fields.evidence: code 4c6c:1998 (copy), a000:0c9a (reset), 4c6c:0df5 (tally adds it); value 0 in all saves

fields.name: stage_counter_c
fields.meaning: Counter cleared when a stage starts; feeds the income term of the post-stage supply tally
fields.evidence: code 4c6c:1998 (copy), a000:0c9a (reset), 7000:92c7 (add), 4c6c:0df5 (tally); value 0 in all saves

fields.name: units
fields.meaning: 100 unit records of 0x22 bytes (unit n at 0x301E + n*0x22). Records 0-9 hold the player and map units in the saves seen; empty records are zero except byte 0x1E
fields.evidence: code 4c6c:1b5e (writer loop, 100 x 0x22 from a 0x26-byte live record), 4c6c:21b8 (loader); turn-1/turn-2 diffs

fields.name: table_140
fields.meaning: 140 records of 12 bytes, copied from the live area with the last three words rotated. Records 0-9 match the 10 used units: byte 4 = record number, word 6 = the same type number as the unit; empty records read 00 00 00 00 FF 00...
fields.evidence: code 4c6c:1cb8 (writer loop), loader 4c6c:2394

fields.name: checksum
fields.meaning: CRC-16 (reflected polynomial 0x8408, start 0xFFFF, result inverted; CRC-16/X-25) over the 0x1AA2 bytes before it; a file with a wrong value is treated as empty
fields.evidence: code 4c6c:18d6 (write), 4c6c:1826 (check), 8000:79b4 (algorithm, table at 8000:79fa); recomputed over all played files (0x7A68, 0x14F5, 0xCA06)

fields.name: unused_tail
fields.meaning: After the third file; never written
fields.evidence: code (files end at 0x7FEC); zero in all saves
